lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Gray mist hangs over the rolling tide
I carry my secrets in the hollows deep
The wood of the boat is my only home
While the stars above begin to slowly sleep
[Chorus]
The salt is heavy in the morning air
I am drifting where the deep waters call
One steady heart in a restless sea
Finding the courage to stand through it all
[Verse]
The waves are whispers of the ghosts I knew
Each crest is a mountain of blue and foam
I steer my spirit through the shifting haze
Searching for a path to lead me home
[Chorus]
The salt is heavy in the morning air
I am drifting where the deep waters call
One steady heart in a restless sea
Finding the courage to stand through it all
[Bridge]
The storm breaks wide and the heavens cry
I am reaching for the light in the sky
[Chorus]
The salt is heavy in the morning air
I am drifting where the deep waters call
One steady heart in a restless sea
Finding the courage to stand through it all
[Outro]
